summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would make it illegal to bring certain cladding materials into the country.
It adds a new section to the Customs Act 1901 that classifies these panels as banned goods under existing import regulations.
The ban would take effect the day after the law receives royal assent, and panels already in Australia would not be affected.
changes: It introduces a new rule that stops the importation of cladding panels with a polyethylene core.
It makes these panels prohibited imports under the Customs (Prohibited Imports) Regulations 1956.
It sets the start date for the ban as the day after royal assent.
summary.affected: Importers of building cladding panels and businesses that supply aluminium composite materials.
